manualAcceptance.source: User message: V8 manual acceptance passed.

validation.reason: No application change, main movement or concrete integration issue requiring rerun

review.authentication: Clerk proxy, sign-in and user-resolution unchanged. Conversation route requires authenticated owned case context before duplicate response lookup.
review.caseFacts: Background facts/routes are in cumulative PR; clinical canonical fixtures unchanged; strict parity/reachability zero findings.
review.dialogue: Shared factual/request boundaries across generation,retry,fallback,rendering,assembly; closure acknowledgment retained.
review.patientQuestions: Typed current-event eligibility and clinical-plan witness; Case3 drainage/agreement implication; once-only markers remain durable.
review.transactions: Final validation before writes inside Serializable transaction; actual9-control verification retained; idempotency/concurrency and rollback covered.
review.retries: Max2 attempts only explicit502/503/504 with250ms backoff,30s shared timeout; no network/app-rejection blind retry.
review.speech: Audio generation/playback components unchanged from main; existing displayed-text-to-playback wiring passes fresh tests; listening unspecified.
review.schemaAndDependencies: No schema,migration,dependency,auth-config or deployment-config diff against current live/main.
review.cosmeticWarnings: git diff --check reports six new blank lines at EOF in frozen source/tests; retained to avoid gratuitous candidate change; no conflict markers or behavior impact.

deployment.name: odontiq
deployment.build: npm ci --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run build
deployment.configurationDrift: render.yaml instead declares build without migration, a migrate-deploy preDeploy command and /api/health HTTP check. Actual service settings govern this release; no remote settings changed.

speechOptionalEnvironment.NAVIGATOR_TTS_VOICE: af_heart fallback; case-specific voice settings apply

deployment.reasonEnvironmentNotInspected: Render connector exposes service/deploy settings but not read-only env-vars; CLI absent and browser dashboard signed out. Existing production readiness/auth checked; exact model/Node/secret configuration must be confirmed in authenticated dashboard before deploy.
deployment.migrationCommand: Existing migrate deploy remains in actual build; expected no-op for this PR; production migration ledger not queried and unexpected pending migrations must stop release.

deploymentSteps: Refresh PR head, current main and current live Render deploy; stop if application tree differs from tested V8 or another production deployment is active.

In authenticated Render Environment/Settings, confirm existing required variables are configured without exposing values. Confirm AI_PROVIDER=navigator, NAVIGATOR_MODEL=granite-3.3-8b-instruct, UF origin and existing Clerk/Neon/TTS configuration. Confirm Node24.14.1 for tested-runtime parity; investigate a different Node/runtime before deploying. Do not save environment changes with a deploy during preparation.
After explicit merge authorization, merge the reviewed PR2 head into main and record resulting merge SHA. Auto-deploy remains OFF, so merge alone does not deploy.

After explicit production-deploy authorization, open the named service Deploys > Manual Deploy > Deploy a specific commit and supply that exact main merge SHA. Retain auto-deploy OFF; do not separately trigger a second deployment.
Monitor the new deploy ID through build/migrations/start until live. Stop on failed build, unexpected pending migration or failed readiness; do not treat queued/accepted as success.

Confirm both /api/health and /api/readiness, login/owned encounter access, actual deployed commit, all-five-case openings, fresh Case4 finance-without-question followed by valid-plan question, Case3 consent/followup, thank-you closure and UI/audio text correspondence. Record production observations; do not erase first failures with retries.

rollback.artifactEligibility: Current live deploy identified; retained rollback-button/build eligibility not independently exposed by connector. Verify when acting; exact-commit rebuild fallback provided.
steps: If the candidate build or readiness fails before traffic switch, confirm Render keeps the current live version; do not deploy again blindly.

For a regression after go-live, use service Deploys, locate the captured target deploy ID and select Rollback > Rollback to this deploy, only with authorization. Confirm auto-deploy remains OFF and wait for rollback live.

If that build artifact is unavailable, use Manual Deploy > Deploy a specific commit with edae56cb34e9a99ada0e1e2e10544686b126dd61, retaining compatible baseline environment and OFF auto-deploy; this rebuilds, so recheck build/runtime rather than claiming identical artifact.
After rollback, verify live target commit, health/readiness, login and a representative encounter; retain incident and first-response evidence.
rollback.dataLimitations: No PR migration/backfill/destructive data change. Rollback does not undo new encounters, transcripts, question emissions, research/test data or external service effects. State schemaVersion1 and question IDs are unchanged; existing emitted markers remain. Do not reset/reverse the DB automatically. Existing out-of-band pending migrations or environment changes would require renewed compatibility review.
rollback.platformConfig: Dashboard rollback restores target build/start/health/env details subject to current platform rules; environment-group values/platform runtime and external database state are not restored. Keep current config snapshot and consult official rollback documentation.

limitations: Existing faculty/application question-timing gaps in validation/v7/AUTHORITY.md and CONTRACT.md remain unresolved.
Finite English-oriented tests and assistant semantic review, not independent clinician review. Previously exposed holdouts are regression data.
One production question-classifier network failure failed closed and remains preserved separately; no retry hid it.
Raw browser traces/screenshots/ledgers and separate harness working tree remain local; app PR contains reports,hashes and results,not the entire external test repository.
User manual acceptance passed but listening was not explicitly confirmed, so human speech audibility remains unverified.
Remote env/model/Node parity and exact production migration ledger not inspected; confirm before deployment.
awaitingAuthorization: Authorize merge of the final reviewed PR2 head into main; separately authorize a manual Render deployment of resulting exact merge SHA only after environment/runtime and migration preflight.
